name: Codex protocol
responsibility: The pinned app-server contract every request and response is decoded against
description: TASK-653.11: 8 names used outside it. decodeFrame(line) reads a line's envelope evidence only and returns the inbound frame; decodeFrameBody(frame, method?) decodes a notification's, request's or response's body as a result, not a throw; encodeFrame(frame, maximumBytes) returns the encoded line or its refusal reason (unencodable, too-large). The session reads decodeClientRequestParams, decodeResponse, ProtocolDecodeError and isClientRequestMethodWithoutParams; the executable and the release build read codexProtocolVersion. It no longer depends on the transport: the wire's errors are the transport's to make from a refusal.
